name: Adobe Bridge
price: Free download with an Adobe account (via Creative Cloud app); Camera Raw editing and Photoshop hand-off need a paid Creative Cloud plan
engine: Adobe's own preview/cache engine with Camera Raw for RAW; video via its own media playback (requires AVX2 on Intel)
summary: Adobe Bridge is a free creative asset manager for browsing folders of photos, design files and video with rich previews. It adds metadata, keywords, ratings, collections, batch renaming and export, and works as the hub for Photoshop, Camera Raw and other Creative Cloud apps.
where_it_wins: Previews of Adobe formats (PSD, AI, INDD, After Effects, Substance 3D) and PDF
Full metadata editing, keywords, labels, ratings, collections and smart collections
Batch rename, Export panel and workflows for bulk conversion
Tight integration with Camera Raw, Photoshop, Premiere and Creative Cloud Libraries
PDF contact sheets, publishing to Adobe Stock and Portfolio
where_schnellbild_wins: No Adobe account, no online activation, no network at all
Plays MKV, WebM, AVI, WMV through built-in VLC; Bridge documents MP4/MOV/FLV
Arrow-key video skimming, subtitles, audio track choice, playback speed
Slideshow through all subfolders with photos and videos mixed
Archives and comics (ZIP, RAR, 7z, CBZ, CBR) as folders
Dual pane with F5/F6 copy and move, boss key
Lightweight and quick to start; no cache build-up
Open source, App Sandbox, build attestation

free.note: Bridge itself is free with an Adobe account; opening/editing RAW in Camera Raw needs a paid Photoshop/Creative Cloud plan

native_apple_silicon.note: Apple silicon M1 or newer supported natively; some features (Auto stack/Panorama) only in Rosetta mode

no_account_no_tracking.note: Adobe ID, internet connection and registration required to activate and use

dark_light_setting.note: Color Theme: Darkest, Dark, Light, independent of the system

folder_browsing.note: Browses folders directly via Folders/Favorites panels, no import

thumbnail_grid.note: Content panel thumbnails, details or list; folder preview tiles not documented

list_view.note: View > As List with metadata columns

recursive_search.note: Edit > Find with 'Include All Subfolders'; Quick Search covers the folder and subfolders

regex_search.note: Find uses criteria/limiters and Match any/all; no regular expressions

network_shares_fast.note: "Browse Quickly By Preferring Embedded Images" and embedded thumbnails for speed; otherwise builds previews and caches

multiple_windows.note: Multi Window plus multiple content panels

bookmarks.note: Favorites panel; drag a folder in to pin it

img_modern_formats.note: Only HEIC/HEIF has a help page; AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP not found in help or release notes

img_raw.note: Thumbnails/previews of camera RAW; editing via Camera Raw needs a paid plan

img_psd_exr.note: PSD previews implied by release notes (PSD preview bug); OpenEXR not found

img_svg_pdf.note: No supported-input-formats page found in Bridge help

keyboard_paging.note: Arrow keys in Content panel, Full Screen Preview and Review mode

zoom_rotate.note: Zoom/pan in Full Screen Preview and slideshow, Loupe tool, rotate in Review mode; rotation is stored as orientation metadata

slideshow.note: View > Slideshow with transitions, captions, pan/zoom

slideshow_recursive.note: Slideshow plays a folder or selection; subfolders and videos in slideshows not documented

auto_enhance_view.note: Preview panel, Full Screen Preview, Review mode and slideshow offer zoom, loupe, rotate, rate, label; no view-only adjustments

file_info_exif.note: Metadata panel with EXIF/IPTC/XMP, including video metadata

video_native.note: Plays MP4/MOV in Preview panel and full screen

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: Plays FLV, F4V, SWF and what the installed QuickTime supports; MKV/WebM/AVI not named

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Content panel shows photos and videos together; video hover preview

video_skim_arrows.note: Hover-scrub in thumbnails, but no arrow-key skimming

subtitles_embedded.note: Preview only offers play, pause, loop, volume

saved_playlists.note: Collections save file sets, not playlists

music_mode.note: Audio files preview with autoplay/loop in the Preview panel

streaming_urls.note: Media preview plays files selected in the Content panel (play, pause, loop, volume)

archives_as_folders.note: Searched Bridge help and Adobe Community; nothing found

comics_cbz_cbr.note: Searched Bridge help and Adobe Community; nothing found

archive_passwords.note: Searched Bridge help and Adobe Community; nothing found

split_archives.note: Searched Bridge help and Adobe Community; nothing found

videos_in_archives.note: Searched Bridge help and Adobe Community; nothing found

manga_two_page.note: Viewing modes are Preview panel (up to nine images to compare), Full Screen Preview, Review mode, slideshow; no reading/spread mode

rename_trash.note: Rename, delete, new folder from the Path bar

move_copy.note: Drag to folders, Copy To/Move To

dual_pane.note: Several content panels/windows side by side; no F5/F6 copy/move

undo_file_actions.note: Copy/move/delete help page does not mention undo

image_editing.note: Quick Actions crop/resize/remove background; pixel editing via Camera Raw/Photoshop (paid)

library_catalog.note: Keywords, ratings, labels, collections and smart collections, without importing

cloud_sync.note: Creative Cloud Libraries, publish to Adobe Stock and Portfolio

keyboard_first.note: Many shortcuts, but workflow is panel- and mouse-oriented

custom_shortcuts.note: Keyboard Shortcuts panel with visual keyboard and layouts

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Help page lists shortcuts and the visual shortcut panel; no printable sheet documented

boss_key.note: Keyboard shortcuts help page is not a complete list

app_sandbox.note: Not in the Mac App Store; entitlements not checkable without installing

no_network.note: Needs internet for activation and validation; online services

notarized_attested.note: Closed source; notarization not checkable without installing, no page found

mac_app_store.note: Not in the Mac App Store (search finds only other Adobe apps)
